description:
Plan: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-structs-and-module-calls.html (approved 2026-11-11) and /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-3sy.8.html (approved 2026-11-13), which moves this ahead of fz-3sy.8. Prerequisites: defoverridable (fz-3sy.7), an item macro's block (fz-3sy.18), defstruct quotable (fz-3sy.20), struct/2 and struct!/2 (fz-3sy.21), __MODULE__ (fz-sc8.75), field defaults (fz-sc8.95, PR #390 under the stack).

Build, as Elixir's kernel.ex: defexception fields -> defstruct([__exception__: true] ++ fields) plus defoverridable exception/1 (binary -> message:, list -> struct!) and message/1 (when there is a message field). Exception.message/1 is e.__struct__.message(e), a module-value call. is_exception/1 guard. raise as Elixir's macro, raise Mod, attrs and raise 42 are fz-3sy.8. The uncaught banner through message/1 is fz-3sy.9.

Acceptance (interp, run, build; elixir oracle):
- defexception with a message field: Mod.exception(message: "x") and raise Mod, "x" rescued by alias, e.message is "x"; default message when built bare.
- custom message/1 used by Exception.message/1; a user-defined exception/1 is honoured.
- is_exception/1 true for a raised struct, false for a plain map with __struct__ only.
- exceptions doc gains the struct section; guides updated if they mention exceptions.
- gate green.
title: defexception, raise Mod, attrs and Exception.message/1
